sections.heading: PROFILE SUMMARY
sections.body: QA Engineer with ==6+ years== of experience in ==manual testing, automation testing, and performance testing== for custom, enterprise-scale web applications. ==Independently planned and executed end-to-end testing==, ==designed, maintained, and evolved manual and automated test suites==, and ==identified, documented, and communicated defects and quality risks== using established defect-tracking tools. Proficient in Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Postman, and SQL.
